issues.desc: index.json description references "Bug 2 (bootstrap atomicity)" as out-of-scope context but provides no cross-story storyId (e.g. B-xxxx); a fresh reader cannot locate it. The parenthetical is informative enough for scope exclusion purposes, but adding the storyId would make it fully standalone-readable.

The outcome statement in the story description is phrased at the engineering level (pick ONE coherent model) rather than as a concrete user-facing transcript. The individual checklist userSees fields compensate, but the top-level outcome could be strengthened to describe what the user observes after completion (e.g. lattice doctor reports clean, bootstrap succeeds on a fresh project with default gitignore).

The existing-project recovery path (for projects already in the data-loss state like ClawCreek) is implicit in CHK-003 doctor repair but not called out as an explicit user-facing scenario. Consider ensuring the doctor repair flow is tested with an already-broken project state, not just prevention on fresh init.
